body:
on the back: “before thursday lunch, a greasy sheen in the cab after the greenhouse test. my wrists blistered. later, the telephone line died.”

The person who handed this to me asked me to keep the date. I did, though the next version left that day out entirely.

I wanted to keep a clean copy, but the stain is where the first entry was crossed out. I have not tried to improve it.
title: cab note — before thursday lunch
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a greasy sheen while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
